JOYO BURGER WELLINGTON

Premium Homemade Smash Burgers in Verdun

JOYO BURGER WELLINGTON - VERDUN'S CRAFT BURGER & BEER DESTINATION

Experience the perfect blend of premium homemade burgers and craft beer culture at our Wellington Street location in Verdun. Situated steps from the beautiful St. Lawrence River waterfront, our modern restaurant has become a cornerstone of Wellington Street's revitalized dining scene. We're proud to serve the vibrant Verdun community with fresh, locally-sourced ingredients and Montreal's finest craft beer selection.

WELLINGTON SPECIALTIES

Experience the perfect pairing of premium homemade burgers and Montreal's finest craft beer at our Wellington location - where waterfront dining meets burger perfection.

Le Bleu

Our signature blue cheese burger with blue cheese sauce, arugula, sautéed onions, caramelized bacon, topped with blue cheese crumble. A Wellington favorite that pairs perfectly with our craft beer selection.

Classic Poutine

Authentic Montreal poutine with hand-cut fries, Quebec cheese curds, and rich gravy. A Verdun tradition made with our signature touch.

Craft Beer on Tap

Fresh Montreal craft beer poured perfectly. Our Wellington location features the city's best breweries, steps from the St. Lawrence waterfront.

FIND US ON WELLINGTON STREET

EXPLORE VERDUN & THE WELLINGTON DISTRICT

Our Wellington Street location places you at the center of Verdun's renaissance. This historic Montreal borough has transformed into one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods, combining waterfront beauty with urban sophistication. After your meal, explore the St. Lawrence River seaway or discover Wellington Street's unique boutiques and cafés.

Why Choose JOYO Burger Wellington?

Our Wellington location embodies the spirit of Verdun's transformation from working-class borough to Montreal's most exciting emerging neighborhood. We've curated Montreal's best craft beer selection to pair perfectly with our premium homemade burgers. Whether you're cycling along the St. Lawrence, exploring Wellington's boutiques, or enjoying Verdun's waterfront parks, JOYO Wellington offers the perfect combination of great food, local beer, and riverside atmosphere.
